item.title: UPDATE: Two males injured in shooting near East Jackson Boulevard
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Elkhart Police Department confirmed with ABC57 they're responding to a shooting with injuries near the Martin's on Jackson Boulevard.

item.title: Culver High School holds second annual Jingle Jam basketball tournament
item.description: CULVER, Ind. -- The second annual Jingle Jam Basketball tournament took place Sunday at Culver High School.

item.title: JUST IN: Single engine aircraft crashes near runway at Elkhart Municipal Airport
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- According to officials with the City of Elkhart, at approximately 4:45 p.m. on Feb. 8, a single engine aircraft crashed near runway 18-36 at the Elkhart Municipal Airport.

item.title: Elkhart County Park offering Survival Skills: Fire Making workshop
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The Elkhart County Parks is offering a Survival Skills: Fire Making workshop on Feb. 21 from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. at the Baldwin One Room School House.

item.title: 17th annual Frosty Five Run invites runners and walkers to winter race
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The City of Elkhart Parks and Recreation Department is holding its 17th annual Frosty Five Run on Saturday, Feb. 14.

item.title: Warsaw-Wayne Fire Territory hosts Push-In Ceremony for new ladder truck
item.description: WARSAW, Ind. -- The Warsaw-Wayne Fire Territory is holding a Push-In Ceremony for Ladder 13 on Wednesday, Feb. 12, from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. at Station 13.

item.title: City of South Bend set to host Black History Month awards ceremony and reception
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The City of South Bend is hosting the eleventh annual Black History Month Awards Ceremony and Reception on Thursday, Feb. 26 at 6 p.m. at the Century Center.

item.title: Martin Luther King Jr. Dream Center set to host Black History Month Skate Night
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Martin Luther King Jr. Dream Center is hosting the third annual Black History Skate Night on Sunday, Feb.15, from 12 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. at Howard Park.
